entities.name: José de Jesús Nuñez Viloria

entities.summary: José de Jesús Núñez Viloria was a Venezuelan Roman Catholic prelate, who served as an auxiliary bishop of Ciudad Bolívar (1982–1987) and a diocesan bishop of Ciudad Guayana (1987–1990).
